Name: Distillery Building
Author: HarrisonGrey
Description:
[i]There have been many attempts to bring alcohol distillation to Stardew Valley, and this here is mine.  Separating my interpretation is one crucial difference; what if, instead of adding a new machine that you had to build dozens of, the distillation process was, ahem, distilled down to its essence:[/i]

﻿Introducing [b]the Distillery[/b], a new farm building that distills a small variety of crops into artisan alcohols.  The Distillery isn't available at the very beginning of the game, though; after participating in a certain ill-advised potato juice experiment, a new Special Order will become available. Once this order is completed, Robin will receive plans for a new distillery and will be able to build it on your farm.  This requires:
﻿[b]25,000 g
﻿10 Hardwood
[/b] [b]﻿7 Copper Bar
[/b] [b]﻿1 Iron Bar[/b]

﻿The Distillery building allows you to put in specific crops and will process them into alcohols overnight.  While specifics can vary per process, this generally requires groups of items being processed into a smaller number of resulting alcohols, with a price that tends to be the item's base price x2, accounting for however many items are required.  This results in a smaller number of higher priced items, which can (almost) all then be aged in Casks.  These processes are:

[list]
[*]5 [b]Potatoes[/b] make [b]Vodka[/b]
Sells for [b]800g
[/b]2 produced per day[*]3 [b]Cactus Fruit[/b] (no star and silver star) make [b]Mezcal[/b]
Sells for [b]450g
[/b]3 produced per day[*]5 [b]Cactus Fruit[/b] (gold and iridium star) make [b]Tequila[/b]
Sells for[b] 1120g
[/b]1 produced per day[*]3 [b]Wine[/b] make [b]Brandy[/b]
Sells for [b]1350g
[/b]2 produced per day[*]3 [b]Grape Wine[/b] make [b]Cognac[/b]
Sells for [b]1500g
[/b]1 produced per day[*]The grains [b]Wheat[/b], [b]Corn[/b], or [b]Amaranth[/b] can be placed in the [b]Dehydrator[/b] to make [b]Malt[/b]
5 [b]Wheat[/b] produce 1 [b]Wheat Malt
[/b]5 [b]Corn[/b] produce 1-2 [b]Corn Malt
[/b]5 [b]Amaranth[/b] produce 1-3 [b]Amaranth Malt[/b][*][b]Wheat Malt[/b] makes [b]Whisky[/b]
Sells for [b]1000g
[/b]1 produced per day[*][b]Corn Malt[/b] makes [b]Bourbon[/b]
Sells for [b]1100g
[/b]1 produced per day[*][b]Amaranth Malt[/b] makes [b]Scotch[/b]
Sells for [b]1600g
[/b]1 produced per day[*][b]Unmalted Grains[/b] (Wheat, Corn, and Amaranth) make [b]Moonshine[/b]
2 [b]Wheat[/b], 3 [b]Corn[/b], or 4 [b]Amaranth[/b] produce 1 [b]Moonshine
[/b]3 produced per day, sells for [b]500g[/b] [i]but[/i] the Governor hates it and after initially shipping it, Lewis will refuse to accept it.  You'll have to ask around to find out where to sell it regularly...[*][b]Berries[/b] of all kinds make [b]Cordials[/b]
Sells for [b]500g
[/b]3 produced per day[/list]
While the Distillery can only process a limited number of each item per day, you can place however many you want in the building and leave them there; the Distillery will process its number per day, and the output items will continue to stack and hold until you pick them up.  Additionally, the Distillery counts each item conversion separately, so you can place a stack of potatoes and a stack of cactus fruit in it, and the next day it will have 2 Vodka and 3 Mezcal ready for you.  
So you don't have to keep checking this mod for the processes or commit them to memory, once you start shipping alcohols made through your Distillery, Gus will send you a letter with some Distillation Notes which detail what crops (and how many) distill into which alcohols.
﻿
﻿For the sake of variety and to match with different recolors, the Distillery comes with four skins; in addition to the default skin, you can also get it in Gold, Dark, or Rustic. You can pick your skin when building your distillery at Robin's shop, or change the skin of an existing distillery with the Paint Building option at Robin's.
﻿
﻿[b]Cornucopia and Atelier Goods Compatibility
[/b]
﻿In addition to alcohols made from vanilla crops, there are also a few extra alcohols and processes that can be made if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia's More Crops[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour's Atelier Goods[/url], or both.  These include:

[i]Cornucopia only[/i]
[list]
[*]5 [b]Juniper Berries[/b] make [b]Gin [/b]
Sells for [b]375g
[/b]3 produced per day[*]5 [b]Sugarcane[/b] make [b]Cacha[/b][b]ça[/b]
Sells for [b]450g
[/b]2 produced per day[*]3 [b]Molasses[/b] (a byproduct of milling Sugarcane and Sugar Beets) make [b]Rum[/b]
Sells for [b]900g
[/b]2 produced per day[*]5 [b]Cassava[/b] or milled [b]Rice[/b] make [b]Soju[/b]
Sells for [b]900g
[/b]2 produced per day[*]5 [b]Barley[/b], [b]Buckwheat[/b], and [b]Durum[/b] make [b]Malt[/b] in the Kiln or Drying Rack
Barley, Buckwheat or Durum Malt make [b]Whisky[/b][*]4 [b]Barley[/b], [b]Buckwheat[/b], or [b]Durum[/b] can also be distilled directly to make [b]Moonshine[/b]
[*]2 [b]Agave[/b] make [b]gold star Mezcal[/b]
[*]2 [b]Blue Agave[/b] make [b]gold star Tequila[/b]
[/list][i]Atelier only[/i]
[list]
[*]3 [b]Elderberry Blossoms[/b] make [b]St. Germaine[/b]
Sells for [b]1020g
[/b]1 produced per day[/list][i]Cornucopia and Atelier[/i][list]
[*]3 [b]Almonds[/b] or 2 [b]St Cannoli Almonds[/b] make [b]Amaretto[/b]
Sells for [b]540g
[/b]3 produced per day[*]3 [b]Wormwood[/b] (Cornucopia) or 5 [b]Wormwood[/b] (Atelier) make [b]Absinthe[/b]
Sells for [b]900g
[/b]1 produced per day[/list]
﻿[b]Compatibilities[/b]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22975]﻿Machine Terrain Framework[/url]: [/b]In addition to the alcohols using Cornucopia crops, if the player has Machine Terrain Framework installed this mod adds a Giant Crop version of Cornucopia's Sugar Cane that can be tapped to provide an additional source of Molasses for Rum production. The chance of the giant crop forming can be configured. Please keep in mind that to reach the tapper, the player needs to be able to access the middle tile in front of the giant crop, so if the giant crop forms on the row of tiles immediately above a water source, you will not be able to harvest the Molasses.
[i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8684]﻿Grapes of Ferngill[/url][/i]: All grapes, including the vanilla grapes, make unique Grape Wine items if Grapes of Ferngill is installed; all Grape Wines can be distilled to make Cognac.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5912]﻿Stardew Vineyard[/url]: Similarly, all wine made from grape varieties can be distilled to make Cognac. Because of the tiered varieties of grapes found in Stardew Vineyard, there are a few color and name variations of Cognac based on the grape used; vanilla Grape Wine results in Cognac, common grapes from SV make Grappa, uncommon grapes make Armagnac, and rare grapes make Vermouth. Despite the names, all of these are internally still Cognac and don't need to be independently shipped to show up on the shipping tab.
﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11676]Joseph's Seed Shop[/url]: Grain and Corn varieties added by Joseph's Seed Shop can be processed in the Distillery to make Moonshine, malted in your configured malt machine, and the malts can then be distilled into Whisky (for the grains) or Bourbon (for the corn). Like Cornucopia, there is some interference with the Dehydrator, as JSS adds Dried Corn as a product; you can configure the malt machine to the Kiln or to the Drying Rack (if you have Cornucopia) in order to get Malted Corn. Cassava Root can also be distilled into Soju.
﻿[i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21720]MPS[/url][/i]: By request, Dehydrator and Cask processes have added compatibility based on MPS. This, however, is based on the older version of MPS, not the current iteration, and may be removed in the future if there are any reported inconsistencies.

[b][size=4] Do you like the building but have your own alcohol items?
﻿[/size][/b][b][size=4]You can [i]mod[/i] this mod![/size][/b]

[b]﻿Config Options[/b]

﻿[b]Products[/b]: ﻿This mod adds the Distillery Building and all the alcohols and processes separately, meaning you can add your own alcohols to this Distillery through your own mod and you can even turn off the alcohols I've included here through the config option [b]Products[/b].  The options are:
﻿"[i]HarrisonGrey[/i]": This selects all my alcohols and processes. [i]This is the default.[/i]
﻿"[i]Custom[/i]": This selects the Custom.json found in assets which you can edit to incorporate your own items.
﻿"[i]None[/i]": This does not add any processes to the Distillery meaning this mod adds the Distillery building and nothing else so that you can add your own alcohols via a separate mod.
﻿More details are available in the Articles tab on how you can add your own alcohol items and processes!

﻿[b]MaltMachine[/b]: Some mods (like Cornucopia and Joseph's Seed Shop) add vegetables to items processed by the Dehydrator, which conflicts with this mod using the Dehydrator to process grains into Malt. As of the 1.0.15 update of this mod, the Dehydrator *should* prioritize the Malt processes over various Dried Vegetable processes, but in case you want to use the Dehydrator for those other products, this config will let you change which machine processes grains into Malts. Options are:
﻿"[i]Dehydrator[/i]": [i]This is the default.[/i]
﻿"[i]Kiln[/i]": This uses the Charcoal Kiln.
﻿"[i]Drying Rack[/i]": If Corncucopia is installed, this uses the Drying Rack found in that mod.

﻿[b]JustGiveIt[/b]: For players installing this mod into an existing farm or if you just want to get to the distilling quickly in a save, this gives you the option to speed up the process of unlocking the Distillery building at Robin's shop.  Options are:
﻿"[i]false[/i]": Unlocking the Distillery is reliant on Special Orders being available, and Pam's Potato Juice quest and Gus's Brewer's Backstock quest being completed.  [i]This is the default.[/i]
"[i]true[/i]": The Distillery is available to build from the beginning of the game; the Brewer's Backstock quest can still show up later.
﻿"[i]Early[/i]": The Brewer's Backstock quest is received via a letter soon after completing Pam's Potato Juice quest.

[b]Credits[/b]
All sprites included in this file are made by me, except for the Malt.  It's the old PPJA sprite, albeit recolored to match the color of the crops it's made from here.  I really intended to make my own sprite but I've been using this one for so long while I came up with my own version of the Distillery and I just really like it.  I'm not sure who originally made it, but thank you, and if you object to me using it here please just let me know.
Russian translation by Moonshine Specialist
German translation by DorsoBasul22
Chinese translation by Sparkling123

[b]Translate Me![/b]
This mod has an i18n file and is fully ready to be translated.  Lines include item names, descriptions, a couple letters, and a few lines of dialogue.

-Fixed an issue with the display name for Cordial when using Cranberries
-Added a Giant Crop version of Cornucopia's Sugar Cane that can be tapped for Molasses
-Tequila now can be either Blanco or Reposado, depending on if it's been aged in a cask.
